summary: Customer is developing a hot polymer extrusion process containing an active pharmaceutical ingredient and wants to investigate optical measurement for detecting composition changes in the melt. They have offline assays, but the process interface is hot and may suffer material build up. They request an initial comparison plan and questions before choosing a probe.
